text: {"lessons":["I tend to hold through declines and trade rarely, so I should review my positions periodically rather than let inattention make every decision for me.","Selling Stock E and Stock D at gains felt satisfying, but a gain relative to my average cost alone does not tell me whether selling is the best choice now.","Selling at a loss feels painful, so I should judge each holding by its future prospects and portfolio role, not just whether I can avoid realizing a loss."]}
